edges.reason: msg.sender receives the entire initial supply in the constructor, so the deployer privilege depends on the caller identity.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender], keyed by the caller.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], keyed by the caller.
transferFrom checks allowed[from][msg.sender], keyed by the caller.
msg.sender indexes the allowance mapping written by approve.
tokenBirth is assigned from block.timestamp, making the recorded birth time depend on miner-controlled time.
getAge reads block.timestamp to compute the token age.
The timestamp subtraction a - tokenBirth is directly driven by block.timestamp.
getAge subtracts tokenBirth from block.timestamp, so the stored birth time controls the result.
tokenBirth is the subtrahend of the timestamp arithmetic in getAge.
getPrice indirectly depends on tokenBirth through the getAge() age value.
getPrice is time dependent because getAge() is derived from block.timestamp.
getPrice calls getAge() and propagates its timestamp-derived return value into the price formula.
totalSupply returns _totalSupply.
Constructor assigns _totalSupply from the initial supply constant.
balanceOf reads balances[tokenOwner].
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approve writes the allowed mapping entry.
Constructor mints the initial supply into balances[msg.sender].
transfer reads and writes balances for msg.sender and the recipient.
transfer updates the balances mapping after the safeSub/safeAdd calls.
transferFrom reads balances[from] and writes both balances entries.
transferFrom reads and decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom writes updated balances for from and to.
transferFrom decrements the allowance entry via safeSub.
transfer performs the sender balance subtraction through safeSub.
transfer performs the recipient balance addition through safeAdd.
transferFrom performs balance and allowance subtractions through safeSub.
transferFrom performs recipient balance addition through safeAdd.
getAge executes the block.timestamp minus tokenBirth arithmetic.
getPrice executes the age multiplication/division price arithmetic.
